title: Skills / development workflow
subtitle: Configure the project once. Read and manage ticket state through the chosen wkc-tracker.

nodes.label: wkc-setup
nodes.summary: Configure the project, select its issue tracker, and write the shared development settings.

details.body: Creates `docs/dev-agents/config.md` and the directories used by the skills. Supports GitHub Issues, Linear, local markdown, or a documented custom workflow.
details.when: Use once per repository, before wkc-tracker; run it again to change the backend or fill missing settings.

nodes.label: wkc-tracker
nodes.summary: Read and update tickets, record dependencies, and find work that is ready to start.

details.body: Provides `list`, `show`, `next`, `create`, `assign`, `comment`, `move`, and `link`. Every change reads current state, writes the change, and verifies it with a separate read.
details.when: Use whenever a person or skill needs to read or change ticket state in the configured backend.

commands.label: Claude Code / Kiro CLI: open tickets
